description_en: Modifies the configurations of an IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用ModifyVpnConnectionAttribute接口修改IPsec连接的配置信息
name: ModifyVpnConnectionAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPsec-VPN connection.  

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接的名称。  

长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block on the VPC side that needs to communicate with the data center. This parameter is used for Phase 2 negotiations.

Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas (,). Example: 192.168.1.0/24,192.168.2.0/24.

Routing modes of the IPsec-VPN connection:

If both LocalSubnet and RemoteSubnet are set to 0.0.0.0/0, the destination routing mode is used.
If both LocalSubnet and RemoteSubnet are set to specific CIDR blocks, the interested traffic mode is used
parameters.help_zh:
需要和本地数据中心互连的VPC侧的网段，用于第二阶段协商。

多个网段之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，例如：192.168.1.0/24,192.168.2.0/24。

关于IPsec连接路由模式的说明：

如果LocalSubnet和RemoteSubnet均输入为0.0.0.0/0，则表示您使用目的路由模式。
如果LocalSubnet和RemoteSubnet均输入具体的网段，则表示您使用感兴趣流模式
parameters.name: local_subnet

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block on the data center side. This parameter is used for Phase 2 negotiations.

Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas (,). Example: 192.168.3.0/24,192.168.4.0/24.

Routing modes of the IPsec-VPN connection:

If both LocalSubnet and RemoteSubnet are set to 0.0.0.0/0, the destination routing mode is used.
If both LocalSubnet and RemoteSubnet are set to specific CIDR blocks, the interested traffic mode is used
parameters.help_zh:
本地数据中心侧的网段，用于第二阶段协商。

多个网段之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，例如：192.168.3.0/24,192.168.4.0/24。

关于IPsec连接路由模式的说明：

如果LocalSubnet和RemoteSubnet均输入为0.0.0.0/0，则表示您使用目的路由模式。
如果LocalSubnet和RemoteSubnet均输入具体的网段，则表示您使用感兴趣流模式
parameters.name: remote_subnet

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the configurations of the IPsec-VPN connection take effect immediately. Valid values:
           
true: Yes. The system immediately initiates IPsec negotiations after the configurations are completed.
   
false: No. The system initiates IPsec negotiations only when traffic is detected
parameters.help_zh:
选择IPsec连接的配置是否立即生效。取值：
           
true：是，配置完成后系统立即进行IPsec协议协商。
   
false：否，当有流量进入时系统才进行IPsec协议协商
parameters.name: effect_immediately

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

The configurations for Phase 1 negotiations: 
           
IkeConfig.Psk: The pre-shared key used for authentication between the VPN gateway and the data center.

    - The key must be 1 to 100 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, and the following special characters: ```~!`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?``` It cannot contain spaces.
    - If you do not specify a pre-shared key, the system randomly generates a 16-character string as the pre-shared key. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526951.html operation to query the automatically generated pre-shared key.
    > The pre-shared key on the IPsec-VPN connection side must be the same as the authentication key on the data center side. Otherwise, the connection between the data center and the VPN gateway cannot be established. 

IkeConfig.IkeVersion: The version of the IKE protocol. Valid values: ikev1 and ikev2. 

    Compared with IKEv1, IKEv2 simplifies the SA negotiation process and provides better support for multi-CIDR block scenarios.

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a ShangMi (SM) gateway, only ikev1 is supported.</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeMode: The negotiation mode of the IKE version. Valid values: main and aggressive.   
    - main: The main mode. The negotiation process is highly secure.
    - aggressive: The aggressive mode. The negotiation process is fast and has a high success rate.

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, only main is supported.</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeEncAlg: The encryption algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations.

    <props="intl"><ph>Valid values: aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm4.</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeAuthAlg: The authentication algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations.

    <props="intl"><ph>Valid values: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm3.</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkePfs: The Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations. Valid values: group1, group2, group5, and group14.

IkeConfig.IkeLifetime: The SA lifetime determined by Phase 1 negotiations. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 86400.

IkeConfig.LocalId: The identifier of the VPN gateway. The identifier can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The default value is the IP address of the VPN gateway. 

IkeConfig.RemoteId: The identifier of the customer gateway. The identifier can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The default value is the IP address of the customer gateway
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

第一阶段协商的配置信息： 
           
IkeConfig.Psk：预共享密钥，用于VPN网关与本地数据中心之间的身份认证。

    - 密钥长度为1~100个字符，支持数字、大小写英文字母以及右侧字符，不能包含空格。```~!`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?```
    - 若您未指定预共享密钥，系统会随机生成一个16位的字符串作为预共享密钥。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526951.html接口查询系统自动生成的预共享密钥。
    > IPsec连接侧的预共享密钥需和本地数据中心侧的认证密钥一致，否则本地数据中心和VPN网关之间无法建立连接。 

IkeConfig.IkeVersion：IKE协议的版本。取值：ikev1或ikev2。 

    相对于IKEv1版本，IKEv2版本简化了SA的协商过程并且对于多网段的场景提供了更好的支持。

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则IKE版本仅支持ikev1。</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeMode：IKE版本的协商模式。取值：main或aggressive。   
    - main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
    - aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高。

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则协商模式仅支持main。</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeEncAlg：第一阶段协商的加密算法。

    <props="intl"><ph>取值：aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值为aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm4。</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkeAuthAlg：第一阶段协商的认证算法。

    <props="intl"><ph>取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm3。</ph></props>

IkeConfig.IkePfs：第一阶段协商使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥交换算法。取值：group1、group2、group5、group14。

IkeConfig.IkeLifetime：第一阶段协商出的SA的生存周期。单位：秒。取值范围：0~86400。

IkeConfig.LocalId：VPN网关的标识。长度限制为100个字符，不能包含空格。默认值为VPN网关的IP地址。 

IkeConfig.RemoteId：用户网关的标识。长度限制为100个字符，不能包含空格。默认值为用户网关的IP地址
parameters.name: ike_config

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

The configurations for Phase 2 negotiations: 

IpsecConfig.IpsecEncAlg: The encryption algorithm used in Phase 2 negotiations.

    <props="intl"><ph>Valid values: aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm4.</ph></props>

IpsecConfig.IpsecAuthAlg: The authentication algorithm used in Phase 2 negotiations.

    <props="intl"><ph>Valid values: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm3.</ph></props>

IpsecConfig.IpsecPfs: The Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations for forwarding packets of all protocols. Valid values: disabled, group1, group2, group5, and group14.   

IpsecConfig.IpsecLifetime: The SA lifetime determined by Phase 2 negotiations. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 86400
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

第二阶段协商的配置信息： 

IpsecConfig.IpsecEncAlg：第二阶段协商的加密算法。

    <props="intl"><ph>取值：aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值为aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm4。</ph></props>

IpsecConfig. IpsecAuthAlg：第二阶段协商的认证算法。

    <props="intl"><ph>取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

    <props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm3。</ph></props>

IpsecConfig. IpsecPfs：转发所有协议的报文，第一阶段协商使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥交换算法。取值：disabled、group1、group2、group5、group14。   

IpsecConfig. IpsecLifetime：第二阶段协商出的SA的生存周期。单位：秒。取值范围：0~86400
parameters.name: ipsec_config

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

The health check configurations:

HealthCheckConfig.enable: Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values: true and false.

HealthCheckConfig.dip: The destination IP address for health checks.

HealthCheckConfig.sip: The source IP address for health checks.

HealthCheckConfig.interval: The retry interval for health checks. Unit: seconds.

HealthCheckConfig.retry: The maximum number of health check retries
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

健康检查配置信息：

HealthCheckConfig.enable：是否开启健康检查。取值：true或false。

HealthCheckConfig.dip：健康检查的目的IP地址。

HealthCheckConfig.sip：健康检查的源IP地址。

HealthCheckConfig.interval：健康检查的重试间隔时间，单位：秒。

HealthCheckConfig.retry：健康检查的重试发包次数
parameters.name: health_check_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically publish route entry. Valid values:

true: Automatically publishes route entry.
   
false: Does not automatically publish route entry
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动发布路由。取值：

true：自动发布。
   
false：不自动发布。
parameters.name: auto_config_route

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

Specifies whether to enable the dead peer detection (DPD) feature. Valid values:

true: Enables the DPD feature. The IPsec initiator sends DPD packets to check whether the peer device is alive. If no correct response is received within the specified time, the peer is considered disconnected. IPsec deletes the ISAKMP SA and the corresponding IPsec SA, and the secure tunnel is also deleted.

false: Disables the DPD feature. The IPsec initiator does not send DPD probe packets
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

是否开启DPD（对等体存活检测）功能。取值：

true：开启DPD功能。IPsec发起端会发送DPD报文用来检测对端的设备是否存活，如果在设定时间内未收到正确回应则认为对端已经断线，IPsec将删除ISAKMP SA和相应的IPsec SA，安全隧道同样也会被删除。

false：不开启DPD功能，IPsec发起端不会发送DPD探测报文
parameters.name: enable_dpd

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

Specifies whether to enable the NAT traversal feature. Valid values:

true: Enables the NAT traversal feature. After this feature is enabled, the IKE negotiation process skips the verification of UDP port numbers and discovers NAT gateway devices in the VPN tunnel.

false: Disables the NAT traversal feature
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

是否开启NAT穿越功能。取值：

true：开启NAT穿越功能。开启后，IKE协商过程会删除对UDP端口号的验证过程，同时实现对VPN隧道中NAT网关设备的发现功能。

false：不开启NAT穿越功能
parameters.name: enable_nat_traversal

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel pattern.

The BGP configurations:

BgpConfig.EnableBgp: Specifies whether to enable the BGP feature. Valid values: true and false.

BgpConfig.LocalAsn: The autonomous system number (ASN) on the Alibaba Cloud side. Valid values: 1 to 4294967295.  

   You can enter the ASN in a two-part format: the first 16 bits and the last 16 bits, separated by a period. Each part must be entered in decimal format.

    For example, if you enter 123.456, the ASN is calculated as follows: 123 × 65536 + 456 = 8061384.

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr: The CIDR block of the IPsec tunnel. The CIDR block must be a subnet with a mask length of 30 within 169.254.0.0/16, and cannot be 169.254.0.0/30, 169.254.1.0/30, 169.254.2.0/30, 169.254.3.0/30, 169.254.4.0/30, 169.254.5.0/30, 169.254.6.0/30, or 169.254.169.252/30.

    > The IPsec tunnel CIDR block of each IPsec-VPN connection under the same VPN gateway instance must be unique.

LocalBgpIp: The BGP IP address on the Alibaba Cloud side. This IP address must be within the IPsec tunnel CIDR block. 

This parameter is required when the BGP dynamic routing feature is enabled for the VPN gateway.
Before adding BGP configurations, understand the working mechanism and limits of BGP dynamic routing. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2638220.html.
Use a private ASN to establish a BGP connection with Alibaba Cloud. Refer to relevant documentation for the range of private ASNs
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

BGP的配置信息：

BgpConfig.EnableBgp：是否开启BGP功能。取值：true或false。

BgpConfig.LocalAsn：阿里云侧的自治系统号。自治系统号取值范围：1~4294967295。  

   支持按照两段位的格式进行输入，即：前16位比特.后16位比特。每个段位使用十进制输入。

    例如输入123.456，则表示自治系统号：123*65536+456=8061384。

BgpConfig.TunnelCidr：IPsec隧道网段。该网段需是一个在169.254.0.0/16内的掩码长度为30的网段，且不能是169.254.0.0/30、169.254.1.0/30、169.254.2.0/30、169.254.3.0/30、169.254.4.0/30、169.254.5.0/30、169.254.6.0/30和169.254.169.252/30。

    > 一个VPN网关实例下每个IPsec连接的IPsec隧道网段需保持唯一。

LocalBgpIp：阿里云侧的BGP地址。该地址为IPsec隧道网段内的一个IP地址。 

当您的VPN网关启用BGP动态路由功能时需要配置该参数。
在添加BGP配置前，建议您先了解BGP动态路由功能的工作机制和使用限制。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2638220.html。
建议您使用自治系统号的私有号码与阿里云建立BGP连接。自治系统号的私有号码范围请自行查阅文档
parameters.name: bgp_config

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in single-tunnel mode.

If the current VPN gateway is an SM VPN gateway, you can modify the CA certificate of the peer.

If the current VPN gateway is a standard VPN gateway, this parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
修改单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

如果当前VPN网关实例为国密型VPN网关，您可以修改对端的CA证书。

如果当前VPN网关实例为普通型VPN网关，不支持配置本参数
parameters.name: remote_ca_certificate

fields.help_en:
The role of the tunnel.

master: The current tunnel is the primary tunnel.
slave: The current tunnel is the secondary tunnel
fields.help_zh:
隧道的角色。

master：表示当前隧道为主隧道。
slave：表示当前隧道为备隧道
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The autonomous system number (ASN) on the Alibaba Cloud side of the tunnel. Valid values: 1 to 4294967295. Default value: 45104.

This parameter can be configured or modified only after you enable the BGP feature for the IPsec-VPN connection (that is, set EnableTunnelsBgp to true).

Use a private ASN to establish a BGP connection with Alibaba Cloud. Refer to relevant documentation for the range of private ASNs
fields.help_zh:
隧道本端（阿里云侧）的自治系统号。自治系统号取值范围：1~4294967295。默认值：45104。

在添加BGP配置前，建议您先了解BGP动态路由功能的工作机制和使用限制。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2638220.html。

fields.help_en:
The authentication algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations.

<props="intl"><ph>Valid values: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, and sha512.</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm3.</ph></props>
fields.help_zh:
第一阶段协商的认证算法。

<props="intl"><ph>取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384、sha512。</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm3。</ph></props>
fields.name: ike_auth_alg

fields.help_en:
The encryption algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations.

<props="intl"><ph>Valid values: aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is a standard gateway, valid values are aes, aes192, aes256, des, and 3des.</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, the only valid value is sm4.</ph></props>
fields.help_zh:
第一阶段协商的加密算法。

<props="intl"><ph>取值：aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为普通型，则取值为aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。</ph></props>

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则仅取值：sm4。</ph></props>
fields.name: ike_enc_alg

fields.help_en: The SA lifetime determined by Phase 1 negotiations. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 86400
fields.help_zh: 第一阶段协商出的SA的生存周期。单位：秒。取值范围：0~86400
fields.name: ike_lifetime

fields.help_en:
The negotiation mode of the IKE version. Valid values:

main: The main mode. The negotiation process is highly secure.
aggressive: The aggressive mode. The negotiation process is fast and has a high success rate.

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, only main is supported.</ph></props>
fields.help_zh:
IKE版本的协商模式。取值：

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高。

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则协商模式仅支持main。</ph></props>
fields.name: ike_mode

fields.help_en: The Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithm used in Phase 1 negotiations. Valid values: group1, group2, group5, and group14
fields.help_zh: 第一阶段协商使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥交换算法。取值：group1、group2、group5、group14
fields.name: ike_pfs

fields.help_en:
The version of the IKE protocol. Valid values: ikev1 and ikev2.

Compared with IKEv1, IKEv2 simplifies the SA negotiation process and provides better support for multi-CIDR block scenarios.

<props="china"><ph>If the VPN gateway is an SM gateway, only ikev1 is supported.</ph></props>
fields.help_zh:
IKE协议的版本。取值：ikev1或ikev2。

相对于IKEv1版本，IKEv2版本简化了SA的协商过程并且对于多网段的场景提供了更好的支持。

<props="china"><ph>如果VPN网关实例类型为国密型，则IKE版本仅支持ikev1。</ph></props>
fields.name: ike_version

fields.help_en:
The identifier on the Alibaba Cloud side of the tunnel, which is used for Phase 1 negotiations. The identifier can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The default value is the IP address of the tunnel.

LocalId supports the FQDN format. If you use the FQDN format, set the negotiation mode to aggressive
fields.help_zh:
隧道本端（阿里云侧）的标识，用于第一阶段的协商。长度限制为100个字符，不能包含空格。默认值为隧道的IP地址。

LocalId支持FQDN格式，如果您使用FQDN格式，协商模式建议选择为aggressive（野蛮模式）
fields.name: local_id

fields.help_en:
The pre-shared key used for authentication between the tunnel and the peer.

The key must be 1 to 100 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, and the following special characters: ```~!`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?``` It cannot contain spaces.

If you do not specify a pre-shared key, the system randomly generates a 16-character string as the pre-shared key. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526951.html operation to query the automatically generated pre-shared key.     

The pre-shared key of the tunnel must be the same as that of the peer. Otherwise, the system cannot establish the tunnel
fields.help_zh:
预共享密钥，用于隧道与隧道对端之间的身份认证。

密钥长度为1~100个字符，支持数字、大小写英文字母以及右侧字符，不能包含空格。```~!\`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?```

若您未指定预共享密钥，系统会随机生成一个16位的字符串作为预共享密钥。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526951.html接口查询系统自动生成的预共享密钥。     

隧道及隧道对端的预共享密钥需一致，否则系统无法正常建立隧道
fields.name: psk

fields.help_en:
The identifier of the peer, which is used for Phase 1 negotiations. The identifier can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The default value is the IP address of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel.

RemoteId supports the FQDN format. If you use the FQDN format, set the negotiation mode to aggressive
fields.help_zh:
隧道对端的标识，用于第一阶段的协商。长度限制为100个字符，不能包含空格。默认值为隧道关联的用户网关的IP地址。

RemoteId支持FQDN格式，如果您使用FQDN格式，协商模式建议选择为aggressive（野蛮模式）

parameters.help_en:
The tunnel configurations.

The parameters in the TunnelOptionsSpecification array are supported only when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in dual-tunnel mode. You can modify the configurations of both the primary and secondary tunnels of the IPsec-VPN connection at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
修改隧道的配置。

仅修改双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置TunnelOptionsSpecification数组下的参数。您可以同时修改IPsec-VPN连接主隧道和备隧道的配置
parameters.name: tunnel_options_specification

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is supported when you modify an IPsec-VPN connection in dual-tunnel mode.

Specifies whether to enable the BGP feature for the tunnel. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh:
修改双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接时支持配置该参数。

是否为隧道开启BGP功能。取值：true或false
parameters.name: enable_tunnels_bgp

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the IPsec-VPN connection was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in UNIX format, which indicates the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
CreateTime.description_zh:
IPsec连接的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建IPsec连接时的总时长

CustomerGatewayId.description_en:
The ID of the customer gateway associated with the IPsec-VPN connection.

This parameter is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
CustomerGatewayId.description_zh:
IPsec连接关联的用户网关ID。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回该参数

Description.description_en: The description of the IPsec-VPN connection

EffectImmediately.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration of the IPsec-VPN connection takes effect immediately. Valid values:

true: Yes. The system immediately initiates IPsec negotiations after the configuration is completed.
   
false: No. The system initiates IPsec negotiations only when traffic enters the connection
EffectImmediately.description_zh:
IPsec连接的配置是否立即生效。

true：是，配置完成后系统立即进行IPsec协议协商。
   
false：否，当有流量进入时系统才进行IPsec协议协商

EnableDpd.description_en:
Indicates whether dead peer detection (DPD) is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection. Valid values:

false: DPD is disabled.

true: DPD is enabled.

This parameter is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
EnableDpd.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否已开启DPD（对等体存活检测）功能。

false：未开启。

true：已开启。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回该参数

EnableNatTraversal.description_en:
Indicates whether NAT traversal is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection. Valid values:

false: NAT traversal is disabled.

true: NAT traversal is enabled.

This parameter is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
EnableNatTraversal.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否已开启NAT穿越功能。取值：

false：未开启。

true：已开启。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回该参数

EnableTunnelsBgp.description_en:
The enabling status of BGP for the tunnel. Valid values:

true: BGP is enabled.
false: BGP is disabled.

This parameter is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in the dual-tunnel pattern
EnableTunnelsBgp.description_zh:
隧道BGP的开启状态。

true：已开启。
false：未开启。

仅双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回该参数

IkeConfig.description_en:
The Phase 1 negotiation configuration.

The parameters in the IkeConfig array are returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
IkeConfig.description_zh:
第一阶段协商的配置。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回IkeConfig数组下的参数

IkeAuthAlg.description_en: The authentication algorithm for Phase 1 negotiations

IkeEncAlg.description_en: The encryption algorithm for Phase 1 negotiations

IkeLifetime.description_en: The lifetime of the IKE SA. Unit: seconds

IkeMode.description_en:
The IKE negotiation mode. Valid values:

main: Main mode. This mode provides high security during negotiations.
aggressive: Aggressive mode. This mode features faster negotiations and a higher success rate
IkeMode.description_zh:
IKE协商模式。

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高

IkePfs.description_en: The Diffie-Hellman (DH) group for Phase 1 negotiations

IkeVersion.description_en:
The IKE version. Valid values:

ikev1
ikev2

Compared with IKEv1, IKEv2 simplifies the SA negotiation process and provides better support for multi-CIDR block scenarios
IkeVersion.description_zh:
IKE协议版本。

ikev1
ikev2

相对于IKEv1版本，IKEv2版本简化了SA的协商过程并且对于多网段的场景提供了更好的支持

LocalId.description_en: The identifier of the VPC. Both FQDNs and IP addresses are supported. By default, this parameter is set to the IP address of the selected VPN gateway
LocalId.description_zh: VPC侧的标识。支持FQDN和IP格式，默认为当前选取的VPN网关的IP地址

RemoteId.description_en: The identifier of the on-premises data center. Both fully qualified domain names (FQDNs) and IP addresses are supported. By default, this parameter is set to the IP address of the selected customer gateway
RemoteId.description_zh: 本地数据中心侧的标识。支持FQDN和IP格式，默认为当前选取的用户网关的IP地址

IpsecConfig.description_en:
The Phase 2 negotiation configuration.

The parameters in the IpsecConfig array are returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
IpsecConfig.description_zh:
第二阶段协商的配置。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回IpsecConfig数组下的参数

IpsecAuthAlg.description_en: The authentication algorithm for Phase 2 negotiations

IpsecEncAlg.description_en: The encryption algorithm for Phase 2 negotiations

IpsecLifetime.description_en: The lifetime of the IPsec SA. Unit: seconds

IpsecPfs.description_en: The DH group for Phase 2 negotiations

LocalSubnet.description_en: The CIDR block on the VPC side

Name.description_en: The name of the IPsec-VPN connection

RemoteSubnet.description_en: The CIDR block of the on-premises data center
RemoteSubnet.description_zh: 本地数据中心侧的网段

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the IPsec-VPN connection belongs.

The IPsec-VPN connection belongs to the same resource group as its associated VPN gateway. You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
IPsec连接所属的资源组ID。

IPsec连接与其关联的VPN网关实例的资源组相同。您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

VcoHealthCheck.description_en:
The health check configuration.

The parameters in the VcoHealthCheck array are returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
VcoHealthCheck.description_zh:
健康检查配置。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回VcoHealthCheck数组下的参数

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether the health check feature is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection. Valid values:

true: The health check feature is enabled.

false: The health check feature is disabled
Enable.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否已开启健康检查功能。

true：已开启。

false：未开启

Interval.description_en: The retry interval for health checks. Unit: seconds
Interval.description_zh: 健康检查的重试间隔时间，单位：秒

Retry.description_en: The number of health check retries
Retry.description_zh: 健康检查的重试发包次数

VpnBgpConfig.description_en:
The BGP configuration.

The parameters in the VpnBgpConfig array are returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in single-tunnel mode
VpnBgpConfig.description_zh:
BGP配置信息。

仅单隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接会返回VpnBgpConfig数组下的参数

EnableBgp.description_en:
The enabling status of BGP. Valid values:

true: BGP is enabled.

false: BGP is disabled

BGP的开启状态。

true：已开启。

false：未开启

LocalAsn.description_en: The autonomous system number on the Alibaba Cloud side
LocalAsn.description_zh: 阿里云侧的自治系统号

LocalBgpIp.description_en: The BGP IP address on the Alibaba Cloud side

PeerAsn.description_en: The autonomous system number (ASN) of the on-premises data center
PeerAsn.description_zh: 本地数据中心侧的自治系统号

PeerBgpIp.description_en: The BGP IP address on the on-premises data center side

Status.description_en:

success: Normal.

false: Abnormal

BGP的协商状态。

success：正常。

false：异常

TunnelCidr.description_en: The BGP CIDR block of the IPsec-VPN connection

VpnConnectionId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection

VpnGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
